_help: The one place that says who each course is for. Everything on the website (home page, Academy, FAQ, course cards) reads this file, so change an age here and it changes everywhere after the next build. Scratch and micro:bit follow the makers' own published guidance (Scratch: 8 to 16, from scratch.mit.edu/help/parents; micro:bit: 8 to 14, from microbit.org/about/mission). The other ages are Techbase's own recommendation.
